  • Method Details

    • customerId

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder customerId(String customerId)
      Sets the customer ID (required).

      The external identifier for the customer in your support platform. For Intercom, this is the external ID you've defined for the user (e.g., "user-123456"). For other platforms, this is the customer identifier used by that platform.

      Parameters:
      customerId - the customer ID
      Returns:
      this builder

    • customerSource

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder customerSource(String customerSource)
      Sets the customer source (required).

      The source of the customer data. For example, a customer ID and phone number might be from Intercom, but the outbound conversation is initiated via Twilio. Use constants from StartOutboundConversationRequest.CustomerSource.

      Parameters:
      customerSource - the customer source
      Returns:
      this builder

    • procedureId

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder procedureId(String procedureId)
      Sets the procedure ID (required).

      The ID of the outbound procedure that defines what the AI agent should accomplish in this conversation. The procedure must be of type "outbound" and must be live (deployed).

      Parameters:
      procedureId - the procedure ID
      Returns:
      this builder

    • supportPlatform

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder supportPlatform(String supportPlatform)
      Sets the support platform (optional).

      The support platform where the conversation should be created. Valid values include "intercom", "zendesk", "freshdesk", "freshchat". If not provided, the system will automatically select the first connected platform in priority order: intercom, zendesk, freshchat, freshdesk, public-api. Use constants from StartOutboundConversationRequest.SupportPlatform.

      Parameters:
      supportPlatform - the support platform
      Returns:
      this builder

    • channel

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder channel(String channel)
      Sets the channel (optional).

      Specifies the communication channel for this conversation. If not provided, defaults to "email". Valid values: "email", "web", "sms", "voice", etc.

      Parameters:
      channel - the channel
      Returns:
      this builder

    • subject

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder subject(String subject)
      Sets the subject (optional).

      The subject line for the initial message (primarily used for email channels). Only used if body is also provided. If both subject and body are omitted, the AI agent will generate the initial message.

      Parameters:
      subject - the subject
      Returns:
      this builder

    • body

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder body(String body)
      Sets the body (optional).

      The content of the initial message to send to the customer. If provided, this message will be sent instead of having the AI agent generate one. If omitted, the AI agent will generate an appropriate initial message based on the procedure.

      Parameters:
      body - the body
      Returns:
      this builder

    • resources

      public StartOutboundConversationRequest.Builder resources(Map<String,Object> resources)
      Sets resources (optional).

      A JSON object containing structured data that the AI agent can use during the conversation. This should be organized as a map where keys are resource type names and values are the corresponding data. Example: {"customer_profile": {"tier": "premium", "lifetime_value": 5000}} The data will be made available to the AI agent for context during conversation processing.

      Parameters:
      resources - the resources
      Returns:
      this builder
